create_agent_cartpole: create an agent_lib.Agent for the Cartpole task with a mujoco MjModel instance
set_agent_cost_weights: set cost weights on the agent using a dictionary mapping cost names to float values
set_agent_task_parameter: set a task parameter such as Goal on the agent with a string key and float value
run_agent_planner_rollout: run an MPC planner rollout by repeatedly calling set_state, planner_step, and get_action in a simulation loop
plot_agent_rollout_results: plot agent rollout results including position, velocity, control, and cost trajectories over time
